message:
Merge pull request #11 from cantrellsolutions: on a 20-core M5 Pro the hyper-connections fused up to 6 were faster than up to 8; --fusion-limit sets it by hand

Merged as e54: its script, page and results were e49 and e46, which are other experiments here. The page put in
this knowledge base's form; gpu-generation, hyper-connections and measurement-noise updated in place, ROADMAP.md
given a section; --fusion-limit documented among the README's options. The engine's own choice is unchanged
(8 from GPU generation 17). The evidence files are as delivered.
